notes.title: Masquerade: Hell Academy - Giveaway
notes.content:
For every 1000 wishlists the game gets on Steam, we will give away 2 game keys!

The winners will be announced one day before the game releases, and you can even choose between the JAST or the Steam version!

More information: [url=https://discord.gg/XavKCtH92u]DISCORD[/url]
